pipeline: domain_classifier (routing) + per-domain logistic-regression specialists on CLIP pre-projection features EXTENDED with a jpeg_q50 reactivity-delta feature, confidence-gated (soft mixture-of-experts) inference
backbone_feature_used: pre-projection embedding (768-dim vision-encoder pooled output, before visual_projection) CONCATENATED with the embedding shift caused by re-JPEG-compressing the image at quality 50 (768-dim delta) = 1536-dim total. See 'Reactivity-delta feature' in README - validated via diagnostic_reactivity_delta.py / diagnostic_reactivity_comprehensive.py / prelim_integration_test.py / prelim_domain_matched_probe.py before production integration (train_reactivity_specialists.py).
domain_classifier: RandomForestClassifier on classical no-reference features (laplacian_var, highfreq_ratio, blockiness, contrast, mean_saturation)
specialist_heads: sklearn Pipeline(StandardScaler, LogisticRegression) per domain group, 1536-dim extended feature, 2506 training images each

reactivity_delta_feature.probe: jpeg_q50 (universal, single probe used for all 5 domains - see scoping note)
reactivity_delta_feature.scoping_note: A domain-matched probe (blur_s1.0 specifically for the 'jpeg' domain, avoiding jpeg-on-jpeg redundancy) measured slightly better for that one domain (+0.008 vs +0.0004) in prelim_domain_matched_probe.py, but was NOT adopted in production: under confidence-gated soft routing every image needs a delta for every specialist it might get weighted to, so domain-matching would require a 3rd CLIP pass per image (both probes) instead of 2, for a gain that only affects the domain with the least headroom (already ~0.99 AUROC). Time-boxed decision given the deadline, not an oversight.
reactivity_delta_feature.validation_summary: cross-source generalization (leave-one-source-out): 0.72 (absolute embedding alone) -> 0.92 (delta alone, jpeg probe). Cross-generator generalization (leave-one-generator-out, Defactify TEST split): 0.909 -> 0.971 (combined). Survives being applied on top of an already-degraded (blurred) input: 0.816 -> 0.911 (combined, LOSO). Full production integration (all 5 domains, real training/eval pipeline): mean AUROC across 16-cell robustness grid 0.981 -> 0.997; generator-diagnostic pooled AUROC 0.940 -> 0.977.

dataset_compliance_summary.sid_set: used, organizer-recommended (saberzl/SID_Set), train split, labels 0/1 only
dataset_compliance_summary.cifake: TRIED (HF mirror of organizer-recommended Kaggle CIFAKE), REMOVED after measured dual regression: -0.020 mean AUROC on own robustness grid, -0.056 AUROC on generator diagnostic. Native 32x32 resolution incompatible with blur/resize/noise robustness testing. See model/*_v4_with_cifake_WORSE.* for the disclosed comparison.
dataset_compliance_summary.wildfake: never fetched (modelscope access friction; explicitly reserved by organizer for demonstration only, not training)
dataset_compliance_summary.defactify_real_images: excluded from training - sourced from MS COCO, and organizer WildFake demo benchmark uses COCO val2017 as its non-AIGC side. Overlap assessed as unlikely (Defactify draws from a ~16k-image pool, val2017 is only 5k) but removed as a precaution since real-photo diversity was already well covered by fullres/sid_set. See model/*_v3_INCLUDES_COCO_REAL* for the prior version.
dataset_compliance_summary.itslen_fullres2: excluded - separately found to be mislabeled (human-art-vs-AI-art, not real-vs-AI-photo); see README Data-quality fix.

generator_diagnostic_final.description: held-out (Defactify TEST split, never trained on) per-generator accuracy, 60 images/class
generator_diagnostic_final.note: the reactivity-delta feature (v6) improved every single cell here over v5 (real 81.7%->88.3%, sd21 86.7%->96.7%, sdxl 98.3%->100%, sd3 91.7%->98.3%, dalle3 95.0%->98.3%, midjourney6 81.7%->96.7%; pooled AUROC 0.940->0.977) - the gain generalizes to unseen generators, not just the training-side robustness grid. Two specific hard, user-found real-world misses (a ChatGPT/DALL-E image of a complex NTU convocation scene, and a deliberately-blurred ChatGPT dog image) remain misses even after this fix (0.030 and 0.008 respectively) - these represent a content/style distribution gap (unusual real-world prompts vs. Defactify's simple COCO-caption-style training examples), a different problem than the generator-identity/robustness gaps this feature targets. See README 'Error analysis' and 'known_failure_examples/'.
